books.title: ROB and the Lost Yellow Ball
books.subtitle: A little robot stops, looks, thinks, and helps
books.description: ROB finds a yellow ball beside a puddle and must stop, observe, plan, and check before helping. This warm illustrated story introduces young readers to sensing, feedback, counting, careful problem-solving, and kindness without presenting imaginary robot actions as real-world engineering evidence.

books.title: Meet ROB
books.subtitle: Building R.O.B. — Volume 1
books.description: Meet ROB through the evidence of a real, hand-built robot project.
